title: FAA UAP reports, batch 21 (237UAP00561 - 237UAP00588)
doc_notes: This document is a collection of FAA Washington Operations Center reports regarding UAP sightings by civilian and commercial pilots between October and December 2023.

incidents.summary: Gulfstream GLF5 reported UAP with lights at 11 o'clock position.
incidents.quote: REPORTED AN UNIDENTIFIED AERIAL PHENOMENON WITH LIGHTS FROM THE 11 O'CLOCK POSITION

incidents.summary: Multiple aircraft reported bright lights through smoke ring or rocket climb.
incidents.quote: MULTIPLE ACFT REPORTED SIMILAR SIGHTING OF AN UNIDENTIFIED AERIAL PHENOMENON CONSISTING OF BRIGHT LIGHTS

incidents.summary: Learjet LJ45 reported silver, softball-sized UAP.
incidents.quote: REPORTED A SILVER, SOFTBALL-SIZED UAP FROM THE RIGHT SIDE

incidents.summary: B763 reported UFO 2,000 feet below.
incidents.quote: REPORTED A UFO 2,000 FEET BELOW WHILE E BOUND

incidents.summary: B739 reported lights from above at 12 o'clock.
incidents.quote: REPORTED LIGHTS FROM ABOVE AT THE 12 O'CLOCK POSITION

incidents.summary: United 541 reported light splitting into two in a criss-cross pattern.
incidents.quote: REPORTED 1 LIGHT SPLIT INTO TWO LIGHTS FLYING IN A CRISS CROSS PATTERN

incidents.summary: American 2928 and FedEx 1402 reported UAP with 3 bright lights.
incidents.quote: REPORTED A UAP WITH 3 BRIGHT LIGHTS

incidents.summary: Pilatus PC12 reported UAP 1,200 feet above; facility observed as primary radar target.
incidents.quote: THE UAP WAS OBSERVED BY FACILITY AS PRIMARY ONLY

incidents.summary: Multiple aircraft reported UAP changing altitudes erratically.
incidents.quote: MULTIPLE ACFT REPORTED AN UNIDENTIFIED AERIAL PHENOMENON CHANGING ALTITUDES ERRATICALLY

incidents.summary: Piper P28A reported three lights in a triangle maneuvering.
incidents.quote: REPORTED UNIDENTIFIED AERIAL PHENOMENA OF THREE LIGHTS IN A TRIANGLE MANEUVERING

incidents.summary: Omni Air 1169 reported bright white UAP.
incidents.quote: REPORTED A BRIGHT WHITE UNIDENTIFIED AERIAL PHENOMENON

incidents.summary: Frontier 4139 reported 2-5 lights moving up/down and left/right.
incidents.quote: REPORTED AS 2-5 LIGHTS MOVING UP AND DOWN THEN LEFT TO RIGHT

incidents.summary: Three aircraft reported large UAP the size of an airliner hovering.
incidents.quote: REPORTED A LARGE UNIDENTIFIED AERIAL PHENOMENON THE "SIZE OF AN AIRLINER" HOVERING

incidents.summary: FedEx 3184 reported UAP with 3 lights in vertical and horizontal arrangement.
incidents.quote: UAP DESCRIBED AS 3 LIGHTS VERTICAL AND HORIZONTAL

incidents.summary: Frontier 31 reported UAP from the left side.
incidents.quote: REPORTED AN UNIDENTIFIED AERIAL PHENOMENON FROM THE LEFT SIDE

incidents.summary: Civilian reported cylindrical shaped UFO at low level.
incidents.quote: REPORTED CYLINDRICAL SHAPED UFO AT A LOW LEVEL

incidents.summary: ATCT reported 5 or more lights at FL400.
incidents.quote: REPORTED AN UNIDENTIFIED AERIAL PHENOMENON (UAP) OF 5 OR MORE LIGHTS

incidents.summary: Gulfstream GLF4 reported UAP below them.
incidents.quote: REPORTED AN UNIDENTIFIED AERIAL PHENOMENON BELOW THEM

incidents.summary: Southwest 498 reported lights moving at high speed.
incidents.quote: PILOT REPORTED LIGHTS MOVING AT HIGH RATE OF SPEED

incidents.summary: Honda HDJT reported 2 objects moving side to side.
incidents.quote: REPORTED AN UNIDENTIFIED AERIAL PHENOMENON OF 2 OBJECTS APPEARING AS LIGHTS MOVING SIDE TO SIDE

incidents.summary: Delta 750 reported UAP from 9 o'clock position.
incidents.quote: REPORTED AN UNIDENTIFIED AERIAL PHENOMENON FROM THE 9 O'CLOCK POSITION

incidents.summary: American 2003 and Delta 2665 reported UAP from 12 o'clock position.
incidents.quote: REPORTED AN UNIDENTIFIED AERIAL PHENOMENON FROM THE 12 O'CLOCK POSITION
